fields.description: Default Bank / Cash account will be automatically updated in Salary Journal Entry when this mode is selected.

fields.description: Only for statistical / employer components (Employer PF, ESI, Gratuity). When set together with Account, the accrual Journal Entry books a self-balancing provision: Dr Account (expense) / Cr this account (liability) — recording the liability for compliance without paying the employee.
fields.label: Payable / Provision Account
